content.privacyIntro: Information about the processing of personal data under Articles 12, 13, 14 and 21 of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
content.controllerNotice: The administrator or operator of this server instance is the data controller within the meaning of the GDPR.
content.dataHeading: 2. Types of data collected and purposes of processing
content.accountNotice: Registration stores your username, email address and a cryptographic password hash. Your email address is used for account activation, password recovery and security notifications.
content.aquariumNotice: The data you enter (aquarium names, dimensions, water parameters, care activities, stocking lists and uploaded images) is stored in the database to provide recording and analysis features.
content.storageLabel: Session cookies & local storage (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR / § 25(2) TDDDG):
content.cookieIntro: A technically essential, encrypted session cookie (
content.cookieNotice: , HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax) is used for user authentication. Display preferences (such as dark mode or filter settings) are stored locally in your browser (localStorage). No advertising or tracking cookies are used.
content.emailNotice: System notifications (verification links, password resets, sharing invitations and configured measurement/fertilization reminders) are sent by email through the configured SMTP server.
content.aiLabel: AI chat assistant & language models (Art. 6(1)(a) & (b) GDPR):
content.aiNotice: Using the AI aquarium assistant is entirely optional (“Bring Your Own Key”). If you add a personal API key for OpenAI (ChatGPT), Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude in your profile and submit a chat request, the aquarium details (name, volume, dimensions, equipment and substrate), stocking (plant and animal species) and up to the last 10 measurements are sent to the selected provider as context to generate relevant answers. API keys are stored securely in the database, displayed only in masked form in the frontend and can be completely deleted from your profile at any time.
content.logsNotice: When you access the application, technical server logs (IP address, timestamp, HTTP status and error messages) are recorded to ensure its functionality, availability and security.
content.localHeading: 3. Local processing, no external trackers & external services
content.localNotice: This application is designed for independent self-hosting. No tracking takes place, and no personal data is shared with third parties or advertising networks. All libraries (including Chart.js) and fonts are loaded locally from the server; there are no external dependencies on third-party CDNs.
content.providerPrivacyNotice: If you choose to use the AI chat feature, communication takes place through the official API of your selected provider. Further information about data processing is available in the providers’ privacy policies:
content.retentionHeading: 4. Retention and complete data deletion (right to be forgotten)
content.retentionNotice: Your data is stored for as long as your user account is active.
content.deletionIntro: You can permanently delete your account yourself at any time in your profile (
content.deletionNotice: ) using the account deletion feature. After confirmation by email, all data linked to the account—including your own aquariums, measurements, alerts, care logs and uploaded photos—is completely removed from the server through cascading deletion (Art. 17 GDPR).
content.rightsHeading: 5. Your rights as a data subject
content.rightsIntro: Under the GDPR, you have the following rights against the data controller:
content.accessNotice: You may request information about your stored data at any time.
content.rectificationNotice: You can correct inaccurate data in your profile or in the respective aquariums.
content.erasureNotice: You may request the complete deletion of your data.
content.portabilityNotice: You can download your measurements at any time in a commonly used, machine-readable format using the integrated CSV/Excel export feature.
content.restrictionLabel: Restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR) & objection (Art. 21 GDPR):
content.restrictionNotice: You may object to data processing within the scope of applicable law.
content.complaintLabel: Right to lodge a complaint (Art. 77 GDPR):
content.complaintNotice: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent data protection supervisory authority.

testInventory.title: 🧪 Water test usage & refills

testInventory.capacityHint: Enter an estimated total capacity to enable the 75% reminder. For drop-count tests, capacity depends on the measured value.

testInventory.noReagent: This value is calculated and does not use its own reagent.
testInventory.resetConfirm: Reset usage for {{name}} to 0? This enables the refill reminder again for the new refill.

health.title: Health & diseases
health.catalogIntro: Disease descriptions, common signs and species-specific information. Filter by water type and species.
health.wizardIntro: First choose the aquarium and the affected resident or group. Then answer questions about symptoms. Available recent water readings are considered automatically.
health.searchPlaceholder: For example white spots or fin rot
health.confirmation: How is the suspected cause confirmed?
health.treatmentNote: Treatment information comes from the supplied dataset. Discuss medication and doses with a fish veterinarian or follow the product instructions; the app does not prescribe treatment or calculate doses.
health.sourceTreatment: Detailed treatment information from the source dataset
health.zoonotic: The source identifies possible transmission to humans. Observe hygiene and seek medical advice if symptoms develop.
health.unsupportedNote: Disabled residents have no species-specific diagnosis data for this aquarium’s water type. This assistant is not intended for plants.
health.noResidents: No residents have been added to this aquarium. Add a resident first.
health.modelNote: A suspected cause, not a confirmed diagnosis. Percentages are relative model estimates from the source data, not clinically validated accuracy rates. Several diseases may occur together.
health.urgent: Abnormal water readings, breathing problems or sudden deaths can be urgent. Check water conditions promptly and contact a fish veterinarian.
health.measurementAge: Automatic answers use readings no more than 24 hours old. Missing or older readings are not assumed to be normal.
health.question: Question
health.unknownHint: If you cannot answer confidently, choose “Not sure”.
health.inconclusive: The available information is insufficient for a clear match. Review the alternatives and obtain professional confirmation.
health.noneNote: No typical disease pattern identified. This does not rule out illness or a cause outside this dataset.
health.noAquariums: Create an aquarium first to start the health check.
health.noAnswersYet: Your answers will appear here during the check.
health.aiChat: Ask AI about this health check
health.chatIntro: Discuss the answers and suspected diagnoses with the AI selected in your profile. Aquarium, resident, latest water readings and wizard results are included as context.
health.chatNotSaved: This chat is not saved in the app. Closing it discards the conversation. Sending shares messages and diagnosis context with your selected AI provider; its retention policies apply there.
health.chatPrompt: How do you interpret the suspected diagnoses, and what should I check next?
